name: autovacuum_vacuum_threshold
description: Minimum number of updated or deleted tuples in a table that triggers an autovacuum VACUUM operation.
symptoms: Bloat accumulation in heavily updated tables
Query performance degradation due to outdated statistics
Increased disk usage from dead tuples
Longer vacuum runtime when deferred too long
tuning_tips: Lower this value for tables with frequent updates/deletes to prevent bloat; raise it for mostly read-only tables to reduce autovacuum overhead. Prefer table-level overrides for heterogeneous workloads.
